The Cursed One#457.src: My duty is not just to serve the Crown, but also to serve you. To make your lives better, to raise this region we live in to new heights.
The Cursed One#457.dst: 我的職責不只是效忠王室，也是服務各位。讓各位的生活更好，把我們共同生活的這個地區推向新的高度。
The Cursed One#457.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#458.src: Whether that's by increasing production of Liff Leaves to share our resources and knowledge the province over, which we owe to your hard work...
The Cursed One#458.dst: 無論是透過增加 Liff 葉的產量，好把我們的資源與知識分享給整個行省——那要歸功於各位的辛勤……
The Cursed One#458.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#459.src: ...or through sharpening our infrastructure to exponentiate your quality of life, in thanks for what you do!
The Cursed One#459.dst: ……還是透過強化我們的基礎建設，讓各位的生活品質指數成長，以答謝各位的付出！
The Cursed One#459.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#460.src: I'd be here all day listing the improvements over the last year, but I'll summarize Multiple major road improvements, countless new job opportunities, multiplying guard patrols to keep you safe...
The Cursed One#460.dst: 要把過去一年的改善一一列出，我大概得在這裡站上一整天，所以我長話短說——多條主要道路改善、無數新的工作機會、加倍的守衛巡邏來保障各位的安全……
The Cursed One#460.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#461.src: The place we came from twenty years ago is unrecognizable now. My vow is that twenty years ahead, I can say the same thing for how much more we, together, improve our home.
The Cursed One#461.dst: 二十年前我們出發的那個地方，如今已經認不出來了。我的誓言是：二十年後，我還能對我們共同把這個家改善了多少，說出同樣的話。
The Cursed One#461.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#462.src: 'til the day we sum up to the grandeur of {p} Thank you all! Enjoy the festivities!
The Cursed One#462.dst: ……直到我們的總和比得上 {p} 的壯麗那一天——謝謝各位！好好享受慶典！
The Cursed One#462.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#463.src: What fine work Sovereign Zhiraok has done for our province! Truly, there could have been no better choice to fill that role!
The Cursed One#463.dst: Zhiraok 統領為我們的行省做了何等出色的工作！要填補那個職位，確實再也找不到更好的人選了！
The Cursed One#463.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#464.src: The {p} flourishes under his governance, and I could not be more pleased by the progress he has made.
The Cursed One#464.dst: {p} 在他的治理下欣欣向榮，而我對他所取得的進展再滿意不過。
The Cursed One#464.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#465.src: One final message before we conclude. These past few years, we have seen fewer and fewer reports of the cursed a sign of our strength as a people.
The Cursed One#465.dst: 在我們結束之前還有最後一件事。過去這幾年，我們收到關於受詛者的通報愈來愈少——那是我們作為一個民族強盛的徵兆。
The Cursed One#465.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#466.src: And it is all thanks to you! Your diligent reporting of suspicious activity makes all the difference in keeping our province safe.
The Cursed One#466.dst: 而這一切都要歸功於各位！各位勤勉地通報可疑活動，正是保障我們行省安全的關鍵。
The Cursed One#466.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#467.src: We must stand strong, together! We will not allow this evil its victory, we will not let our province fall like so many others have beyond our walls!
The Cursed One#467.dst: 我們必須團結、堅定！我們不會讓這份邪惡得勝，我們不會讓我們的行省像牆外那麼多地方一樣淪陷！
The Cursed One#467.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#468.src: With that, let the celebrations begin!
The Cursed One#468.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#470.src: Did anything stand out to you?
The Cursed One#470.dst: 有什麼特別引起你注意的嗎？
The Cursed One#470.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#471.src: Indeed, it is. It's quite puzzling, isn't it? It's a sort of reverence she never displays elsewhere.
The Cursed One#471.dst: 確實。這很費解，不是嗎？那是一種她在別處從不流露的敬意。
The Cursed One#471.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#472.src: And if there's one thing I'm certain she's being truthful about, it's this. Which only makes it all the stranger.
The Cursed One#472.dst: 而如果有一件事我確定她說的是真話，就是這一件。這反而讓它更加奇怪。
The Cursed One#472.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#473.src: Yes, yes... improvements. Life has improved since he ascended to that position. I'll give him that. He's invested in Auburn.
The Cursed One#473.dst: 是啊，是啊……改善。自從他升上那個位置，生活確實變好了。這一點我認。他確實投入在 Auburn 上。
The Cursed One#473.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#474.src: But he is still working under the crown. Don't forget that. For every improvement he has made, there's another he has left ignored.
The Cursed One#474.dst: 但他仍然是在王室底下做事。別忘了這一點。他每做出一項改善，就有另一項是他放著不管的。
The Cursed One#474.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#475.src: No, I suppose they wouldn't. Better to leave the public unaware of such failures.
The Cursed One#475.dst: 不，我想他們不會提。讓大眾不知道那些失敗，對他們比較好。
The Cursed One#475.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#476.src: But rest assured that internally, they have not forgotten. They will keep searching for you.
The Cursed One#476.dst: 但你可以確定，在內部他們並沒有忘記。他們會繼續找你。
The Cursed One#476.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#477.src: Yes... the cursed. The crown needs to keep the people afraid. If there's another enemy out there that the crown supposedly protects them from...
The Cursed One#477.dst: 是的……受詛者。王室需要讓人民保持恐懼。如果外面還有另一個敵人，而王室宣稱保護他們免於那個敵人……
The Cursed One#477.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#478.src: There's a reason they want people to believe the outside world is destroyed. Any contact could break the illusion.
The Cursed One#478.dst: 他們要人們相信外面的世界已經毀滅，是有原因的。任何接觸都可能戳破那個幻象。
The Cursed One#478.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#479.src: They'll be closing out the festival soon... so, our work here is done. We should be leaving before the crowd thins enough for us to be spotted.
The Cursed One#479.dst: 他們很快就要結束慶典了……所以我們這裡的工作完成了。我們該在人群散到足以讓我們被認出來之前離開。
The Cursed One#479.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#480.src: I've scheduled a meeting for tomorrow I'd like for you to attend. It'll be about our next steps, now that the crown has moved on. I'll see you there.
The Cursed One#480.dst: 我明天安排了一場會議，希望你能出席。內容是關於下一步——既然王室已經移動了。到時候見。
The Cursed One#480.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#482.src: I think I've had just about enough of people sneaking into my office. Care to knock next time?
The Cursed One#482.dst: 我想我對有人溜進我的辦公室這件事已經受夠了。下次能不能敲個門？
The Cursed One#482.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#483.src: Mmn. It's more interesting this way. I have news from the capital your request for additional troops has been granted. Reassignments should come through by the end of the week.
The Cursed One#483.dst: 唔。這樣比較有意思。我從首都帶來消息——你增派部隊的請求批准了。調動應該在本週結束前下來。

The Cursed One#484.src: Well, that'll solve some problems. But that's not the whole message, is it? What obtuse remark has he got for me this time?
The Cursed One#484.dst: 嗯，那能解決一些問題。不過那不是全部的訊息，對吧？他這次又要我聽什麼鈍話？
The Cursed One#484.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#485.src: Merely a reminder to... "get your act together," as it were.
The Cursed One#485.dst: 只是提醒你……用他的說法，「振作一點」。

The Cursed One#486.src: Get my act toge That floundering fractal's developed less in his quadrant in a hundred-fifty years than I've done in two, in the last ten!
The Cursed One#486.dst: 振作一——那個原地打轉的碎形在他那個象限裡一百五十年做的事，還不如我這十年裡兩年做的！
The Cursed One#486.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#487.src: I Ugh, focus, Z... He's not even here, don't let him get under your skin...
The Cursed One#487.dst: 我——唉，專注，Z……他人根本不在這裡，別讓他惹到你……
The Cursed One#487.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#488.src: I'll get off that tangent. If that was all you had to say, it'd be a waste of your time. What do you need to say that a courier can't send in a letter?
The Cursed One#488.dst: 我不扯那條切線了。如果你要說的就這些，那才是浪費你的時間。有什麼是信差送信送不了、非得你親口說的？
The Cursed One#488.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#489.src: The intruder. Does your administration believe it can get the situation under control?
The Cursed One#489.dst: 那個入侵者。你的行政單位相信自己能控制住局面嗎？

The Cursed One#490.src: There it is. Listen, I've got their number, alright? There's no way in or out of the district where they won't be detected. We'll track them down.
The Cursed One#490.dst: 來了。聽著，我已經掌握他們的數了，好嗎？這個轄區沒有任何一條進出的路是他們不會被偵測到的。我們會把他們找出來。
The Cursed One#490.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#491.src: Though unlike some people, my ego isn't so massive I can't recognize when an ally can be of use. Your types have an expertise here, so if you could spare a set or two of eyes it'd be much appreciated.
The Cursed One#491.dst: 不過跟某些人不一樣，我的自尊還沒大到認不出盟友什麼時候能派上用場。你們那一類在這方面是專家，所以如果你能撥一兩雙眼睛過來，我會非常感激。
The Cursed One#491.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#492.src: I'll see what I can do. There happens to be an ongoing operation in the area already, we can discuss redirecting the agent once it's concluded.
The Cursed One#492.dst: 我看看能做什麼。這一帶剛好已經有一項行動在進行，等它結束之後，我們可以討論把那名探員轉調過來。

The Cursed One#493.src: One last thing the identity of the intruder has been made clear to you already, yes?
The Cursed One#493.dst: 最後一件事——入侵者的身分已經明確告知你了，對吧？

The Cursed One#494.src: Mhm. Like I said, I've got their number.
The Cursed One#494.dst: 嗯哼。就像我說的，我掌握了他們的數。
The Cursed One#494.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#495.src: Then you will understand Her Majesty's order not to speak of this ordeal to our newest. Ascension is a difficult process, and it would be... unwise to add additional distractions to it.
The Cursed One#495.dst: 那你就會明白女王陛下的命令——這件事不得向我們那位最新的成員提起。飛升是個艱難的過程，替它添上額外的干擾會是……不明智的。

The Cursed One#496.src: Wouldn't want to distract a hard worker like him, right. But if that's everything, Spymaster? My to-do list is getting more added by the minute.
The Cursed One#496.dst: 可不想打擾一個這麼勤奮的人，是吧。不過如果就這些了，諜報總管？我的待辦清單每分鐘都在增加。
The Cursed One#496.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok
